# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows build and process checks contribute to the pull-request `all checks passed` verdict; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. Python runtime CI checks Linux/Windows x64 on pull requests and Linux ARM64 plus both macOS architectures on main pushes; releases retain all five targets ([platform policy](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-06-master-only-platform-ci.md)). `ci.yml` is pull-request-only. `ci-main.yml` carries the post-merge lint, type-check, duplication, and unit gates on a GitHub-hosted runner, because `ci.yml`'s jobs target enterprise, Blacksmith, and self-hosted pools this repository does not have. Main-only platform checks, Linux/Windows self-hosted standbys, and manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which listens to main pushes and `workflow_dispatch`, not `pull_request`; separating workflow triggers keeps main-only jobs out of PR check panels. Jobs whose runners or credentials exist only at the upstream repository — the two self-hosted standbys and the external-key python runtime carrier — carry a `github.repository` guard, so a fork without that infrastructure skips them instead of queueing or failing on every main push. The post-merge standbys validate the self-hosted failover targets; preserve the existing per-platform switches (values `selfhosted` for the in-house standbys and `blacksmith` for Blacksmith's hosted runners) and the Dependabot hosted fallback under the `selfhosted` values ([failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md), [blacksmith failover leg note](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-09-blacksmith-failover-leg.md)).
